title: Motor Fault Detection
description: Classify induction-motor faults for industrial equipment from vibration, current, and torque.
long_description: Train a model in DEEPCRAFT™ Studio to separate a healthy motor from 11 fault classes, including faults that occur together. The classes cover common industrial faults that are otherwise hard to catch early, such as bearing defects, broken rotor bars, winding shorts, and eccentricity. This project is for industrial applications, such as monitoring pumps, fans, compressors, and conveyors driven by induction motors.
